set.body:
Objective:
Build optional ecosystem leverage around the completed independent Frame foundation without moving backend, format, numerical, or scheduler concerns into frame-core.

Tracks:
- Parquet source/sink with truthful decode and pushdown capabilities.
- DuckDB engine with complete-plan translation first and Arrow batch handoff.
- Gale numerical bridge with explicit null, chunk, layout, ownership, and allocation policies.
- Later evidence-driven spill, segmented execution, asynchronous pulls, and physical planning.
- Conformance, explain receipts, examples, and release boundaries for every optional artifact.

Architectural law:
Optional adapters depend on Frame. Frame does not depend on their implementations or semantics. The local JVM/Scala.js engine remains the semantic reference. Installing or omitting an adapter cannot change a Frame plan, schema, or default result contract.

Out of scope unless a named consumer and conformance plan exist:
Spark translation, formula languages, regression/PCA APIs in Frame core, distributed schedulers, remote object stores, and universal zero-copy claims.

Epic acceptance:
All child adapter and evidence gates close; each artifact has an explicit support matrix and independent lifecycle; and Frame remains fully useful and testable with none of these optional modules present.
set.title: Epic: Frame adapters — Parquet, DuckDB, Gale, and advanced execution without core coupling
